processing.cumulative_energy_time_definition: cumulative sum of three-component squared filtered velocity; T90=t95-t05, matching REL3 and half-space workflows
processing.peak_energy_time_definition: median tmax over multiple smoothing windows applied to three-component analytic-signal intensity
processing.inferential_estimator: median of 57 nonoverlapping 10-station block medians, with block bootstrap and Wilcoxon on the same block medians
processing.receiver_geometry: REL3 606-station geometry reconstructed by the validated generator; Vx/Vy rotated to R/T at each station

evidence_index.title: Input files are structurally aligned but have unequal record lengths
evidence_index.takeaway: All six files contain the same r1-r606 sequence and finite Vx/Vy/Vz samples; M5-M6 extend to 400 s, so 50-245 s and 50-395 s have different inferential roles.

evidence_index.title: Only a heterogeneity-present topography x low-velocity conditional design is identifiable
evidence_index.takeaway: M3/M4/M5/M6 identify four conditional contrasts; missing low-velocity/no-heterogeneity cells and unverified random seeds prevent a complete three-factor interaction.

evidence_index.title: Low velocity changes S12 phase structure across Z, R, and T
evidence_index.takeaway: Shared-scale S12 traces show that the change is not a scalar amplitude correction.

evidence_index.title: A large fraction of low-velocity S12 energy lies after 245 s
evidence_index.takeaway: The low-velocity S12 records continue accumulating energy through the extended window; M5 and M6 t95 are 368.2 and 381.9 s.

evidence_index.title: The low-velocity runs increase integrated energy, duration, and delay
evidence_index.takeaway: Spatial-block median energy factors are 19.72 (flat) and 12.04 (topography), while T90 factors are 1.50 and 1.41; absolute amplitude/energy attribution assumes unchanged source and run settings.

evidence_index.title: The low-velocity effect is path dependent
evidence_index.takeaway: Ray-specific medians differ substantially; a single global multiplier would hide propagation-direction dependence.

evidence_index.title: Low velocity further redistributes energy among Z, R, and T
evidence_index.takeaway: The new models reduce median Z fraction and increase horizontal/transverse fractions relative to their M3/M4 baselines.

evidence_index.title: Transverse conversion is background dependent
evidence_index.takeaway: T-fraction changes differ between flat and topographic backgrounds and cannot be represented by a universal conversion factor.

evidence_index.title: The marginal topographic effect changes across the low-velocity runs
evidence_index.takeaway: The spatial-block median topographic energy factor changes from 1.78 without low velocity to 0.99 with low velocity; causal attribution remains conditional on unverified run equivalence.

evidence_index.title: Topography-by-low-velocity interaction is metric-specific and mixed
evidence_index.takeaway: Interactions are supported for selected amplitude, energy, timing, late-energy and T-fraction metrics, while T90, tmax, t95, Z and R intervals include zero; the effect is not uniformly nonadditive.

evidence_index.title: Peak and energy topographic fingerprints are retained more clearly than T90
evidence_index.takeaway: Distance-controlled block correlation for total-energy topographic effects is rho=0.53 (q=0.00011), whereas T90 is not significant (q=0.095).

evidence_index.title: Path relief must be re-evaluated in the low-velocity background
evidence_index.takeaway: The report tests the relationship directly rather than importing the no-low-velocity result.

evidence_index.title: Low-velocity runs slow and disorder energy-peak migration within the 400 s window
evidence_index.takeaway: Spatial-block median common-window tmax shifts are 111.7 s and 101.0 s; boundary-affected stations are explicitly marked and excluded in sensitivity slopes.

evidence_index.title: The main energy ridge remains closer to linear distance than R-squared diffusion
evidence_index.takeaway: All ray-model fits prefer the linear form in the full and censor-safe samples; minimum Delta AIC favoring linear is 51.9 and 12.8, respectively. These are descriptive 400 s-window tests.

evidence_index.title: Envelope similarity can improve while waveform phase remains poor
evidence_index.takeaway: Zero-lag three-component correlation and lag-tolerant energy-envelope correlation measure different properties and are reported together.

evidence_index.title: Data-selected traces verify the distribution-level effects
evidence_index.takeaway: Representative stations are selected by effect quantiles and matched distance, not by visual preference.

evidence_index.title: Low velocity moves the early S12 envelope toward Apollo but does not reproduce the long coda
evidence_index.takeaway: M5/M6 peak-energy times (213.2/272.5 s) are later than M1-M4 but remain far earlier than the observed 658.3 s.

evidence_index.title: Timing improvement does not solve the phase and duration mismatch
evidence_index.takeaway: M5/M6 early 3C waveform correlations are -0.058/0.080; observed t95 is 2804.6 s.

evidence_index.title: The low-velocity time-frequency pattern remains much shorter than Apollo
evidence_index.takeaway: Low-velocity synthetics prolong band-limited energy to 400 s, whereas observed energy remains strong over much longer times.

evidence_index.title: Some 400 s low-velocity metrics remain right censored
evidence_index.takeaway: Primary stations with t95 in the final 20 s: M5=118, M6=132.

evidence_index.title: Low-velocity delay is distance-structured, nonmonotonic, and path dependent
evidence_index.takeaway: The delay grows, saturates or declines over different distance intervals and rays, ruling out one constant static correction.

evidence_index.title: Spatial-block intervals separate robust effects from unstable medians
evidence_index.takeaway: Bootstrap intervals use 57 nonoverlapping 10-station spatial blocks rather than treating 575 neighboring stations as independent.

evidence_index.title: Transverse conversion varies systematically along the three profiles
evidence_index.takeaway: M5/M6 T-fraction profiles show that conversion is spatially structured rather than a single model-wide percentage.

evidence_index.title: Low-velocity peak and duration timing estimates depend strongly on the available window
evidence_index.takeaway: Cross-model effects use 50-245 s; extended tmax/t95/T90 values are reported separately and flagged near the 395 s boundary.

quality_flags.distance_fit_sensitivity: censor_safe excludes tmax within 20 s of either analysis boundary and t95 within 20 s of the 395 s endpoint
